title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E4 — The Pal-Mir Escort
Assassins attempt to stop Steve from delivering an ailing prime minister scheduled for the first bionic-heart implant.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E5 — The Seven Million Dollar Man
The emotional instability of a stronger bionic-man than Steve forces a showdown; guests Monte Markham, Maggie Sullivan.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E6 — Straight on 'Til Morning
Steve ignores a potential radiation hazard to help an alien (Meg Foster) evade authorities and rejoin her ship.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E7 — The Midas Touch
Steve winds up trapped in a mine when he tries to prove Oscar is innocent of gold-smuggling; guest Farley Granger.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S3 E3 — Fembots in Las Vegas
A scientist's son, planning to steal an energy-ray weapon, reactivates his father's deadly female robots.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S3 E4 — Fembots in Las Vegas
After launching the energy weapon into space, deranged Franklin holds Jaime, Oscar and Rudy hostage.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S3 E5 — Rodeo
A scientist (Andrew Prine), whose mind contains the only record of a secret code, endangers himself in rodeos.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S3 E6 — African Connection
Jaime teams with a grizzled old-timer (Dan O'Herlihy) to prevent an African dictator (Raymond St. Jacques) from seizing power.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S3 E7 — Motorcycle Boogie
Motorcycle daredevil Evel Knievel is enlisted to help Jaime retrieve a stolen computer tape from East Germany.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E5 — Burial Ground
Michael tries to save an Indian burial ground from a greedy oil man; guests Robert Pine, Gina Gallego.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E6 — The Wrong Crowd
A motorcycle gang hijacks a Foundation truck containing computers and forces a young computer whiz to break into a local bank.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E11 — Musical Mania
Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E12 — Helpful
An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E13 — Drivers
An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E14 — School Days
The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E15 — The Professor
Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E16 — Syndrome
Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).
